component.name: miniam
component.summary: Play Apple Music in the terminal
在终端里播放 Apple Music

description.p: miniam plays Apple Music in a terminal window. A hidden browser window streams the audio while the terminal shows true-color album art, the track title and a live spectrum, so you can keep music playing while you work.
miniam 在终端窗口里播放 Apple Music。后台浏览器负责推流，终端里显示真彩专辑封面、歌名和动态频谱，写代码时也能一直放着歌。

ul.li: True-color album art rendered with Unicode quadrant blocks
用 Unicode 象限字符渲染真彩专辑封面
Live spectrum with several styles that follow the music
动态频谱，多种样式跟随音乐起伏
Keyboard playback controls: play/pause, next, previous
键盘控制播放：暂停/继续、下一首、上一首
The spectrum reads only its own audio stream, so other apps' sound does not move it
频谱只读自己这一路音频，别的程序出声不影响它

screenshot.caption: miniam in a terminal: cover art, track title and a live spectrum

description.p: Desktop integration: the .desktop entry, AppStream metadata and hicolor icons now ship with the release tarball, so miniam can be listed in Discover and other software centres.
Fluid wave spectrum, four spectrum styles, status line on the top row and the spectrum flush with the bottom edge.
